data.long_meaning: Goddess of the Forest, the Mother of All Creatures, and the Protector of the Wild. The name Theri carries the meaning “Mother of the Forest” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Tamil. Parents who choose Theri usually hope their child will grow to embody mother of the forest and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Theri" is rooted in the rich Hindu mythology and culture, which holds high reverence for nature and its elements. The word "Theri" is derived from the Sanskrit word "Tharini," which translates to 'the one who bears.' In Hindu folklore, there is a goddess named "Theri," who is the embodiment of the power and protection of forests and animals. She is often depicted as a fierce, powerful figure, usually carrying multiple weapons, and is regarded as the mother of all creatures — wild and tame alike. She is also the revered protector of forests and the wilderness, championing the preservation and nurturing of nature.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Theri" holds immense spiritual significance in Hinduism. It resonates with the divine feminine energy and represents the nurturing, caring, and maternal aspects of the universe. As the Goddess of the Forest and the Protector of the Wild, Theri embodies the fierce, powerful, and protective aspects of the divine mother. She is believed to be the presiding deity of all wild creatures, ensuring their lives are healthy, prosperous, and abundant. She is a reminder that nature and its creatures play a vital role in the balance of life on Earth and warrants protection and care. In spiritual practices, the name "Theri" can serve as a reminder of the interconnectedness of all beings in the universe and the importance of harmony and balance.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Theri in Hinduism symbolizes the fierce and protective spirit of a tiger. It is believed to bring courage, strength, and determination in the face of challenges, inspiring one to embrace the wildness and power within oneself.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Theri is a name of a demon king in Hindu mythology. The name Theri carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Theri is a demon king mentioned in Hindu epics like the Mahabharata and Ramayana.
